items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] A recent Joe Williams record he did. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah that’s right, he did Joe’s last album.

ctx.x: No but if you want to hear great arrangements, listen to anything Johnny Mandel wrote or Robert Farnon who was the daddy of all the arrangers. He’s got some great albums, Schwartz and Dietz songs, made in England, unbelievable orchestrations.
A recent Joe Williams record he did.

Oh yeah that’s right, he did Joe’s last album. But I mean he did an instrumental and then you hear the melody with either violin or trombone or maybe electric guitar playing like © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
